blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Make combat_readability closure-ready for enemy rifle animation, distributed combat AI, and authoritative combat feedback while preserving clean boot, accepted mission result flows, input/reset behavior, retained weapon/viewmodel setup, and current environment lighting baseline.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active blocker is not a missing telemetry row; prior Tester evidence says living Charlie rifle actors, specifically rift_c_06 and rift_c_07, still lose rifle-family compatibility during grounded locomotion/reposition. The candidate already has enemy roster, fixture, snapshot, humanoid presentation, combat feedback, and HUD plumbing, but the repeated failure pattern means another transform or report-tuning pass is inadequate. This loop should repair the enemy presentation binding or restore the last visually accepted rifle-ready baseline while separately advancing the PRD-required combat AI and event feedback surfaces.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or edit preserved first-person weapon/viewmodel assets, source gun audio, accepted result media, or the registered 3D FPS map/environment tuple unless fresh candidate-bound evidence proves that exact preserved surface is the cause.

Do not relabel neutral, pistol, rail, spell, or interaction clips as final rifle compatibility; if no coherent rifle-ready source or accepted baseline can be bound, leave the rifle-animation issue open with a precise asset/baseline blocker rather than fabricating a pass.
Do not use tester_* setup actions as proof of route reachability, milestone completion, or end-to-end mission success; they may only accelerate branch-local inspection after one ordinary-input smoke.
If Godot MCP or runtime capture is unavailable, classify the infrastructure gap and do not claim visual, animation, audio, or performance acceptance from source inspection alone.
Tester owns formal closure of issues and phase checks; Developer self-validation may only make the candidate closure-ready.

strategy.rationale: Stagnation requires a materially different strategy from repeated transform tuning. First repair the humanoid rifle binding at the presentation/baseline boundary for the specific living Charlie locomotion failure, then use existing deterministic encounter fixtures to exercise AI states and feedback event joins across prepared and advanced combat branches.

code: Run the project import/bootstrap or equivalent clean boot check and keep validate:clean_boot passing.
Run focused script/scene checks for parse errors in edited GDScript and broken scene/resource paths after any humanoid, enemy, HUD, or feedback edit.
